title: Kasba Ganpati
text:
Kasba Ganpati (कसबा गणपती) — 1 (Pehila Manacha), located in Kasba Peth, Pune, established 1639.

History: Kasba Ganpati is the Gramdevata (presiding deity) of Pune and holds the most revered position among all Ganesh mandals in the city. The idol was found near the home of Vinayak Thakar, close to where Jijabai (mother of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj) resided; on her orders the temple was built in 1639. Shivaji Maharaj is said to have sought this Ganpati's blessings before every campaign. The idol is swayambhu (self-originated), originally rice-grain sized, grown over centuries from devotees' red sandalwood paste. Lokmanya Tilak declared it Pune's Gramdevata and gave it the first Manacha position when public Ganeshotsav began in 1893. Visarjan of all other mandals begins only after Kasba Ganpati's immersion.

Idol/Deity: Swayambhu idol, originally rice-grain sized, grown over centuries via sandalwood paste offerings; simple Peshwa-style temple.

Temple/Mandir address: Kasba Peth, Pune 411011 (near Shaniwar Wada & Lal Mahal). Festival pandal address: TO UPDATE — announced by mandal closer to festival (Aug 2026). Maps link: TO UPDATE — check Kasba Ganpati Mandal Facebook/Instagram in August 2026. Coordinates: 18.51889, 73.85694.

Aarti timings — Morning: Mangala Aarti: 5:45 AM; Evening: Sayan Aarti: 9:00 PM.

Special events during the 10 days: Grand Visarjan procession led by Mayor & Commissioner; Mhapurush Darshan on Day 1.
